description: This Perl script reads data from a specified file, sets the CONTENT_LENGTH environment variable, passes the data to a command via a pipe, enforces a timeout, and waits for the command to complete. It appears to be a utility for invoking commands with input content and handling execution constraints.

methods.name: main logic
methods.description: Performs reading a file, piping its contents to a command, setting a timeout, and managing process termination.
